title: Topping Out
tagline: Competitive construction scheduling on a real CPM engine
card_blurb: Competitive construction scheduling on a real CPM engine: a critical path that moves under you, cure times nothing can shorten, and a seeded event deck — same bad luck for every team.
description: **Topping Out** — competitive construction scheduling for CM class. Real precedence-diagram CPM recomputed every turn (forward/backward pass, total and free float, FS/SS/FF with lags), a computed critical path that shifts and announces itself, non-compressible cure and inspection holds, trade stacking, a sourced overtime decay curve, and a seeded event deck so every team faces the identical run of bad luck. 4D cutaway, Gantt and network views, week-by-week debrief. Includes a printable instructor guide.
